title: Opportunity Card
description: Central contract for LLM-generated opportunity cards. Required by llm_gateway.mjs for schema validation.

opp_id.description: Opportunity unique identifier for cross-snapshot tracking (M4)

snapshot_type.description: Whether this card is a draft scan or a deep-dive snapshot (M4)

model_used.description: LLM model identifier used to generate this card (M4)

p_range.description: Probability range [low, high] ∈ [0,1]. Constraint: low ≤ high (JSON Schema draft-07 does not support cross-field validation; enforced at application layer).

confidence.description: Information quality assessment for this opportunity (M4)

risk_triggers.description: Risk trigger labels (max 3) flagged during evaluation (M4)

veto.description: Hard gate veto decision for this opportunity (M4)

rule_facts.description: Key-value facts from the rule engine that triggered this decision

evidence_refs.description: Evidence pointer references (URLs, file paths, or IDs) supporting this opportunity (M4)
